capabilities.title: Clarification for ambiguous or incomplete user requests

cases.description: no entity, no KPI, no period at all -- classic ambiguous case
answers: Which aspect of AB InBev's performance would you like? For example, a specific KPI (revenue, volume, normalized EBITDA, etc.), reporting zone, and time period (quarter/year)?

cases.description: vague pronoun with nothing prior to resolve it against
answers: What would you like to know about? For example, AB InBev's overall performance, a specific zone, country, or brand?

cases.description: asks for 'the numbers' without saying which
turns: Can you give me the numbers?
answers: Could you specify which numbers you'd like? For example, revenue or EBITDA for a specific zone and period (e.g., Q3 2025 North America)?

cases.description: names a KPI but no zone/period at all
answers: Which margin would you like? For example, EBITDA margin, and for which period and zone (e.g., Q3 2025, North America)?

cases.description: reasonable default exists (company-wide, latest period implied) -- should NOT force clarification
turns: What was AB InBev's total revenue last year?
cases.reason: unavailable=False, answer='AB InBev’s total revenue last year (latest annual Global figure) was **$59,320 million**, or approxi'
answers: AB InBev’s total revenue last year (latest annual Global figure) was **$59,320 million**, or approximately **$59.32 billion** USD.

cases.description: a fully-specified question should NOT trigger clarification
turns: What was North America's revenue in Q1 2024?
answers:
North America's revenue in Q1 2024 was **$3,593 million (USD)** (i.e., $3.593B). [Source: structured KPI data]

Want to compare this against Q1 2023 or see the Q2 2024 figure for trend?

cases.description: clarification question itself should be specific, not generic filler
answers: Would you like an overall AB InBev performance summary? If so, which period and region should I focus on?

cases.description: multi-turn: clarification, then the user supplies the missing piece
cases.reason: unavailable=False, answer='North America revenue for Q1 2024 was **$3,593 million (USD)**.\n\nThis figure comes from the structur'
answers: Which performance metrics would you like (e.g., revenue, volume, normalized EBITDA) and for which period/zone?

North America revenue for Q1 2024 was **$3,593 million (USD)**.

This figure comes from the structured KPI data for the North America zone, revenue metric, Q1 2024.

Would you like to see this compared to the prior-year quarter, or broken out by brand or country?
